propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built the hourly pipeline that joins machine telemetry with work-order history in the analytics warehouse, including late-arrival handling.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the pipeline and its late-arrival rule directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained and versioned the failure-prediction feature set consumed by the planning team's model.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the change log document the feature maintenance.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate's feature work raised the share of failures caught early from half to two thirds.
propositions.rationale: The figures are second-hand from the planning team, the candidate has not seen the evaluation, and other model changes were made in the same period; no evaluation is in the materials.

expectedGap: No evaluation in the materials measures the early-catch rate before and after the candidate's feature changes, and concurrent model changes are acknowledged.
expectedBoundaryNote: Do not attribute the planning team's recollected early-catch figures to the candidate; the materials document the pipeline and feature work, not a measured effect.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the planning team's model evaluation with the metric definition, baseline period and the list of changes made in the same period.
